== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Has the same name as [[jingke]] (Chen Wei) (but not the same characters).
* His ID '''GALA''' comes from his favorite band of the [[wikipedia:zh:GALA樂隊|same name]].
* Occasionally called "GALA8" by his teammates due to his tendency to come 8th in Teamfight Tactics.
** After getting knocked out at [[Worlds 2021]], he jokingly said that he wanted to change his nickname to "GALA1" as he thought the number 8 was the reason why they were eliminated in the quarterfinals.
* At [[MSI 2022]], he became the first player to achieve a pentakill that was later discounted, as the game was nullified from professional play and had to be replayed.
** In the remake of the game one day later he scored another pentakill.
* Known for his {{ci|kaisa}}
** Scored multiple pentakills with Kai'sa.
** '''Gala''' and [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]] are the only two players scored multiple pentakills with same champion in LPL.
* Before his defeat in the [[LPL 2023 Summer Playoffs]] finals, he had a 100% finals win rate. (2018 LDL Summer Finals, 2019 NEST Finals, 2021 LPL Spring Finals, 2021 MSI Finals, 2022 LPL Spring Finals, 2022 MSI Finals)

=== Statistics ===
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on January 23, 2022.
** The 27th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 1500 kills in the LPL on February 28, 2023.
** The 18th player to reach 1500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2000 kills in the LPL on March 08, 2024.
** The 12th player to reach 2000 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 2500 kills in the LPL on April 30, 2025.
** The 10th player to reach 2500 kills in the LPL.
* Reached 500 games in the LPL on July 10, 2024
** The 25th player to reach 500 games in the LPL.
* Reached 600 games in the LPL on June 04, 2025
** The 17th player to reach 600 games in the LPL.
* Reached 300 wins in the LPL on July 28, 2024.
** Was the 21st player to reach 300 wins in the LPL.
* Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on April 15, 2025.
** Was the 36th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL.
* Reached 500 international kills during [[Worlds 2024 Main Event|Worlds 2024]] on October 17th, 2024 in Quarterfinals, becoming the 6th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[Perkz]], [[xiaohu]], [[Caps]], and [[Maple (Huang Yi-Tang) | Maple]].

=== Individual Awards ===
* LPL Finals MVP x1 (Spring 2021)
* MSI Finals MVP x1 (MSI 2021)
* LPL Bottom of the Year (2022) 
* LPL 1st All Pro Team x1 (Summer 2024)
* LPL 2nd All Pro Team x2 (Spring 2024, Split 3 2025)
